en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal town's small harbor. A group of people stand along a stone pier that extends into the water; a small rowboat is moored beside it. Low, traditional buildings line the waterfront with hills or mountains in the distant background. Printed captions appear below the image indicating the location in French and Greek. There is also a circular logo on the left and a website watermark at the bottom.
